title: Binance confirms employee targeted as three arrested in France break-in
summary: French police arrested three suspects after a break-in targeting a Binance France executive, RTL reported. Binance has confirmed a home invasion involving an employee.

title: Are quantum-proof Bitcoin wallets insurance or a fear tax?
summary: Post-quantum Bitcoin wallets are already on sale, leaving investors to decide whether they’re buying insurance or paying up fear tax.

title: Crypto CEO gets 20 years for $200M Bitcoin Ponzi scheme
summary: A federal judge sentenced PGI founder Ramil Palafox to 20 years in prison for running a Bitcoin Ponzi scheme that raised over $200 million from customers between 2019 and 2021.

title: 22 Bitcoin worth $1.5M vanish from Seoul police custody
summary: The loss was uncovered during an audit launched after a separate 320 Bitcoin custody failure, raising fresh concerns over digital asset management by authorities.

title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias agree merger to build European crypto hub
summary: Boerse Stuttgart will merge its crypto arm with Tradias, creating a regulated European crypto unit providing services in trading, custody, staking and tokenized assets.

title: Aave Labs seeks $50M grant to redirect product revenue to DAO
summary: Some community members questioned the size of the $50 million package and warned that the proposed AAVE token grant could concentrate voting power.

title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $410M as Standard Chartered slashes BTC target
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs are on track for a fourth consecutive week of losses as Standard Chartered cut its 2026 Bitcoin target to $100,000.

title: ETHZilla offers token tied to jet engine leases amid tokenization pivot
summary: Crypto treasury firm ETHZilla recently sold some of its crypto to begin a tokenization push by buying two jet engines leased to a US airline.

title: Crypto use in human trafficking networks surged in 2025: Chainalysis
summary: Chainalysis says that despite the rising use of crypto in trafficking networks, the transparency of blockchain may give visibility into the operations, aiding law enforcement.

title: Israel arrests two over Polymarket trades on military operations
summary: Israeli authorities said a military reservist and a civilian were arrested after allegedly using classified information to place bets related to military strikes on Iran.
